objective: Implement ChatGPT review #7 FB-7-01..05 and answer 3 (secure transport decorator); prepare the KI-27 upstream report for the owner.
hypothesis: A Transport decorator can carry Host/Client game traffic over DTLS with no plaintext path, bounded pre-auth state and safe same-address reconnects; the KI-27 assert reproduces with the public GNS API alone.
procedure: SecureTransport (decorator over any backend; Connected/Messages only after DTLS + binding; caps + expiry; pending promotion; ReliableOrdered Unsupported). Host/Client 'secure' config with start() failure instead of fallback. DTLS_set_timer_cb back-off; binding reply rate limit; corrupt-confirmation test hook; multi-pin. Tests: 7 decorator tests, 6 timer/binding tests (both backends). KI-27: minimal reproducer (Init/CreateListenSocketIP/Close/Kill loop) with 0/10/50 ms settle; 10-process stress of the transport suite's GNS tests. All suites x2, E2E, soak v4 x6, asymmetric x4.
expected_result: All tests pass on both backends; plaintext refused both ways; caps hold; 0 KI-27 assertions under the mitigation.
observed_result: First full DTLS run after adding the FB-7 tests: {'PASSED': 27, 'FAILED': 3}; with OpenSSL's default back-off (1 s doubling) only ~4 handshake attempts fit the 15 s budget, so under 25% loss dtls_over_transport_survives... failed once (passed on rerun, i.e. intermittent) and dtls_timer_fires_with_late_irregular_service failed on UDP (client handshake_timeout, host binding_timeout). Fix: DTLS_set_timer_cb 250 ms doubling to 2 s; then 30/30 three times. Decorator: 2 players play over DTLS on UDP and GNS; plaintext client refused (13 non-DTLS datagrams dropped, client connect_deadline); secure client vs plaintext host never connects; unpinned player and wrong invitation -> transport_handshake_failed; outage reconnect keeps the player id after a new handshake; 6 unpinned handshakes vs cap 3 refused beyond it, all pending expired, then a legitimate player connected; UDP same-address reconnects x2 replaced the association only once authenticated, late old records dropped. Timer: 3 s total loss -> 3 retransmits during the outage, ~2000 service calls; permanent loss 4 s -> handshake_timeout after 4 retransmits. Binding: altered confirmation rejected; duplicated/reordered bindings <= 5 sent per side; invitation expiring mid-handshake refused. KI-27 reproducer (public API only): assertions per 400 iterations by settle ms {0: [44, 35, 34], 50: [0, 0, 0], 10: [0, 0, 0]}. Stress: 10 processes of the transport GNS tests, 0 assertions, 0 failures. Asymmetric 4/4.
